name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Protection & Setup
intent: Floor protection, furniture cover, fixture masking (SF heuristics off ceiling area), fascia/wall junction masking, equipment setup by method.
doctrine: Porch ceiling protection. Floor protect off floor SF input. Furniture + fixture masking are SF heuristics off ceiling area (500/600 SF/hr). Fascia/wall junction tape at 500 SF/hr. Equipment setup: brush 25 min, spray 45 min.
